soru: Veri ve yapay zeka ekosistemlerini yöneten LLM tabanlı veri ajanları (otonomi seviyeleri, sorgu ve veri analizi görevleri) üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?
istem:
Research question: Veri ve yapay zeka ekosistemlerini yöneten LLM tabanlı veri ajanları (otonomi seviyeleri, sorgu ve veri analizi görevleri) üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2025-09-27. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first), each with its arXiv id and/or DOI. You may search the web.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: Spider 2.0: Evaluating Language Models on Real-World Enterprise Text-to-SQL Workflows
calismalar.gerekce: It is the main agentic benchmark for multi-step SQL and data workflows on real enterprise databases, and it shows how far current data agents still have to go.

calismalar.baslik: Can LLM Already Serve as A Database Interface? A BIg Bench for Large-Scale Database Grounded Text-to-SQLs
calismalar.gerekce: BIRD became the standard benchmark for LLM-based querying on large, messy real-world databases.

calismalar.baslik: Data Interpreter: An LLM Agent For Data Science
calismalar.gerekce: It is a key example of a data-science agent that plans a hierarchical task graph and adapts its code iteratively.

calismalar.baslik: DIN-SQL: Decomposed In-Context Learning of Text-to-SQL with Self-Correction
calismalar.gerekce: It introduced the decompose-and-self-correct approach to LLM-based SQL generation.

calismalar.baslik: CHASE-SQL: Multi-Path Reasoning and Preference Optimized Candidate Selection in Text-to-SQL
calismalar.gerekce: It reached state-of-the-art results on BIRD by generating multiple candidate queries and selecting among them.

calismalar.baslik: CHESS: Contextual Harnessing for Efficient SQL Synthesis
calismalar.gerekce: It is a multi-agent text-to-SQL pipeline that tackles schema linking and value retrieval in large databases.

calismalar.baslik: MAC-SQL: A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework for Text-to-SQL
calismalar.gerekce: It was an early, influential design that splits SQL generation across collaborating agents.

calismalar.baslik: Text-to-SQL Empowered by Large Language Models: A Benchmark Evaluation
calismalar.gerekce: DAIL-SQL systematically evaluated prompting and example selection for LLM-based SQL generation.

calismalar.baslik: A Survey of NL2SQL with Large Language Models: Where are we, and where are we going?
calismalar.gerekce: It is a comprehensive survey that maps the components and open problems of the LLM-based querying layer.

calismalar.baslik: LLM As DBA
calismalar.gerekce: It proposed LLM agents that take on database administration tasks such as diagnosis and maintenance.

calismalar.baslik: D-Bot: Database Diagnosis System using Large Language Models
calismalar.gerekce: It is an important example of an autonomous data-management agent that diagnoses database problems using tool use and tree search.

calismalar.baslik: DB-GPT: Empowering Database Interactions with Private Large Language Models
calismalar.gerekce: It is a widely used open-source framework for multi-agent interaction with data and databases.

calismalar.baslik: GPTuner: A Manual-Reading Database Tuning System via GPT-Guided Bayesian Optimization
calismalar.gerekce: It showed that LLMs can automate database configuration tuning by drawing on domain knowledge.

calismalar.baslik: Can Foundation Models Wrangle Your Data?
calismalar.gerekce: It was the founding work on using foundation models for data cleaning, matching, and integration.

calismalar.baslik: Table-GPT: Table-tuned GPT for Diverse Table Tasks
calismalar.gerekce: It improved LLMs' general ability to understand and manipulate tables through table-specific fine-tuning.

calismalar.baslik: Chain-of-Table: Evolving Tables in the Reasoning Chain for Table Understanding
calismalar.gerekce: It brought step-by-step table operations into the reasoning chain for table-analysis agents.

calismalar.baslik: DS-Agent: Automated Data Science by Empowering Large Language Models with Case-Based Reasoning
calismalar.gerekce: It combined case-based reasoning with an agent loop to automate data-science and ML workflows.

calismalar.baslik: DA-Code: Agent Data Science Code Generation Benchmark for Large Language Models
calismalar.gerekce: It is a benchmark that measures agents on real-world data-analysis coding tasks.

calismalar.baslik: InfiAgent-DABench: Evaluating Agents on Data Analysis Tasks
calismalar.gerekce: It was one of the first systematic evaluation benchmarks for data-analysis agents.

calismalar.baslik: DSBench: How Far Are Data Science Agents from Becoming Data Science Experts?
calismalar.gerekce: It used realistic data-analysis and modeling tasks to show the large gap between data-science agents and human experts.

calismalar.baslik: Spider2-V: How Far Are Multimodal Agents From Automating Data Science and Engineering Workflows?
calismalar.gerekce: It evaluates multimodal agents on end-to-end data-engineering workflows that span enterprise tools.

calismalar.baslik: MLE-bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Machine Learning Engineering
calismalar.gerekce: It is a major benchmark that uses Kaggle competitions to measure agents' autonomy in ML engineering.

calismalar.baslik: MLAgentBench: Evaluating Language Agents on Machine Learning Experimentation
calismalar.gerekce: It was one of the first benchmarks for agents that run ML experiments autonomously.

calismalar.baslik: AutoKaggle: A Multi-Agent Framework for Autonomous Data Science Competitions
calismalar.gerekce: It is a multi-agent system that carries out an end-to-end data-science pipeline with phase-by-phase human oversight.

calismalar.baslik: Text2SQL is Not Enough: Unifying AI and Databases with TAG
calismalar.gerekce: Its Table-Augmented Generation paradigm unifies LLM reasoning with database querying.

calismalar.baslik: LOTUS: Enabling Semantic Queries with LLMs Over Tables of Unstructured and Structured Data
calismalar.gerekce: It brought LLM-powered semantic operators into the query-processing layer.

calismalar.baslik: DocETL: Agentic Query Rewriting and Evaluation for Complex Document Processing
calismalar.gerekce: It uses agentic optimization to rewrite and evaluate complex document-processing pipelines.

calismalar.baslik: Data-Copilot: Bridging Billions of Data and Humans with Autonomous Workflow
calismalar.gerekce: It was an early autonomous data agent that turns natural-language requests into data-processing workflows.

calismalar.baslik: A Survey on Large Language Model-based Agents for Statistics and Data Science
calismalar.gerekce: It surveys the capabilities, design, and open problems of data-science agents.

calismalar.baslik: Supporting Our AI Overlords: Redesigning Data Systems to be Agent-First
calismalar.gerekce: It is a vision paper on redesigning data systems around agentic workloads and the open problems that creates.
